identity.mission: Create a Log Analysis Dashboard that feels like a tactical command center. Precision, speed, and clarity are paramount. No generic SaaS fluff.

structure.sidebar: w-64 hidden md:flex flex-col border-r border-border bg-surface
structure.header: h-16 border-b border-border flex items-center px-6 justify-between bg-surface/50 backdrop-blur-xl

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,122,255,0.3)] rounded-md font-medium transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-surface border border-border hover:bg-surface_highlight text-white rounded-md transition-all

cards.base: bg-surface border border-border rounded-lg overflow-hidden relative group

inputs.base: bg-surface_highlight border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-md text-white placeholder:text-text_secondary/50

charts.style: Minimalist, thin lines, gradient fills with low opacity. Tooltips must be dark glassmorphism.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background to reduce digital flatness.

images.description: Abstract neon lines on dark background. Use with low opacity (5-10%) as a background texture for the main dashboard area or empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY: Start by setting up the global theme variables in index.css to match the 'Performance Pro' palette.
LAYOUT: Build a responsive shell with a sidebar (collapsible on mobile) and a main content area.
THEME_TOGGLE: Ensure the theme toggle switches between the 'Deep Obsidian' dark mode and a 'Stark White/Gray' light mode (Swiss Style).
FILE_UPLOAD: Create a distinct 'Drop Zone' area. It should feel like inserting a data cartridge. Use dashed borders that turn solid/glow on drag over.

LOG_VIEWER: This is the core. It must look like a high-end terminal. Use JetBrains Mono. Implement virtualization if possible or simple overflow-auto for MVP. Color-code log levels (ERROR=Red, INFO=Blue, WARN=Yellow).
AI_SUMMARY: Present this as a 'Mission Report'. Use a typewriter effect for the text generation if possible, or just a clean fade-in.
CHARTS: Use Recharts. Create a toggle to switch between Line (Trends) and Bar (Counts). Ensure axes are legible.
EXPORT: Simple, functional buttons. 'Export PDF', 'Export Text'.
DEMO_DATA: Add a 'Load Simulation' button that populates the dashboard with fake data instantly for testing.
CRITICAL: Do not use default Shadcn card styles. Remove the heavy shadows and use 1px borders with subtle background differentiation.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - generic centered layouts and gradients.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Prioritize existing Shadcn components but customize them via className.
